subject: ClinicAI discovery — token econ recap & target $/1M ask
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <emorris@clinicai.com>, Chris Patel <chris.patel@clinicai.com>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0400
Subject: ClinicAI discovery — token econ recap & target $/1M ask

Elena / Chris — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and next steps so we’re aligned: 

Recap (what I heard)
- Primary use: large-scale summarization and chart-generation for provider-facing dashboard.
- Pilot volume: ~500M tokens / month (inference tokens) for first 3 months.
- Year-1 scale target: 3B tokens / month if pilot metrics hold.
- Procurement cadence: PO + 3-month pilot -> expand to reserved capacity if QoS meets SLA.
- Compliance: VPC + SOC2 evidence required; will ask Security to review.

Budget / target economics (you mentioned during call)
- Budget range: $25k–$40k / month for pilot (you said $30k as a realistic starting point).
- Target unit ask: you’re hoping for a target at-or-below ~$10 per 1M tokens (goal).

Redwood framing (what we can do)
- Pilot proposal: recommend a 3-month pilot at $9/1M tokens (discounted) with auto-fallback to hosted variants; includes 24/7 support and token-level cost dashboards.
- Long-term anchors: with reserved capacity and quantized model variants we can get towards $6–8/1M at scale depending on throughput and latency SLOs.
- Competitive context: we’ll run a quick benchmark vs OpenAI and Anthropic equivalent endpoints and two open-host providers (quantized vs unquantized) so you can compare unit economics + SLA tradeoffs.

Immediate asks / next steps
1) Please confirm pilot volume (500M/mo) and that $30k / mo is an acceptable starting budget.
2) Share any procurement timeline constraints (PO, legal redlines) — you mentioned end of Q3 as ideal.
3) I’ll share a token-econ model and a short competitive snapshot by EOD — Ben will run host parity numbers and Camila will pull reserved-capacity uplift scenarios.

Attachments: redwood_token_econ_model.xlsx (workbook with scenarios) — I’ll send an updated sheet after Ben’s numbers.

Thanks again — I’ll follow up with the benchmarking note and a proposed SOW draft for legal.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com | (415) 555-0148

From: Elena Morris <emorris@clinicai.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Chris Patel <chris.patel@clinicai.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: ClinicAI discovery — token econ recap & target $/1M ask

Thanks Jasmine — appreciate the clear recap. Confirming the core points: 
- Pilot: yes, 500M tokens/mo sounds right for the first 90 days.
- Budget: internally we’re comfortable targeting $30k/mo for the pilot; we can stretch to $40k if latency/SLA require more reserved throughput.
- Target unit: aiming for <= $10/1M long-term; $9 pilot price sounds reasonable as a conversation starter.
- Compliance: we need SOC2 attestation and VPC peering. Security will request an evidence pack (Std attachments: SOC2 report, data retention policy, audit logs).

Procurement note: Procurement wants a 45–60 day review for any contract >$50k. If the pilot is structured as a 3-month PO under $50k total, it accelerates approval.

Please include the competitive snapshot — we want to see the total landed cost vs OpenAI/Anthropic and at least two open-host options (with quantized variants called out).

Elena
Elena Morris
Head of Product Operations, ClinicAI
emorris@clinicai.com | (212) 555-0211

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 17:03:00 -0400
Subject: Fwd: ClinicAI discovery — token econ recap & target $/1M ask

Ben / Camila — forwarding ClinicAI’s confirmation (below). Quick internal action list so we can turn around the competitive snapshot and SOW: 

Quick facts
- Pilot: 500M tokens/mo x 3 months (confirmed).
- Pilot budget: $30k/mo (ClinicAI prefers pilot under $50k total to avoid long procurement).
- Long-term target: <= $10/1M tokens.

Requests (priority order)
1) Ben — can you produce a short host-comparative matrix (single-slide) showing effective $/1M token landed to customer for: OpenAI (gpt-4 equivalent), Anthropic (Claude-like), and two open-host providers (one GPU-hosted quantized LLM, one hosted managed open model). Call out: list price, expected throughput constraints, quantization delta (if applicable), and observed token latency tradeoffs. Put a recommended anchor price for Redwood for pilot vs long-term (suggested: pilot $9/1M, long-term $7/1M with reserved commits).
2) Camila — run reserved-capacity uplift scenarios for 3B tokens/mo (year-1 target). Show required GPU pool, estimated committed monthly cost, and resulting $/1M if we assume 70% utilization.
3) I’ll update the redwood_token_econ_model.xlsx with both outputs and prepare a SOW-draft for legal to review (attach SOW-draft.pdf).

Timing: need both deliverables by EOD tomorrow (Mon 8/17) so we can get the snapshot to ClinicAI Tuesday morning.

Thanks — I’ll propose pilot commercial terms in the slide so Sales Ops can review.

—Jasmine

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 18:42:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Fwd: ClinicAI discovery — token econ recap & target $/1M ask

Got it — will run numbers and share a compact slide + a short note with benchmarking assumptions. Quick top-line from an initial run (ballpark, to be validated):

Benchmark (preliminary) — effective landed $/1M (customer-facing)
- OpenAI-equivalent (hosted latest): ~$22–26 / 1M (depends on sampling/temperature costs and streaming vs non-streaming).
- Anthropic-equivalent: ~$18–22 / 1M (Claude-like model pricing tends to be slightly lower for same latency/SLA).
- Open-host (managed, unquantized): ~$12–15 / 1M (higher infra cost, less optimized serving).
- Open-host (quantized, optimized runtime): ~$6–9 / 1M (best-case with 4-bit quantization + throughput-friendly runtime; may not meet lowest-latency SLOs).

Recommended commercial anchors for ClinicAI (based on their ask and procurement constraints)
- Pilot (3 months, 500M/mo): $9 / 1M (discounted, includes monitoring + SOC2 evidence pack + 2 support seats). Estimated pilot invoice: ~$4,500 / month at 500M tokens -> wait that's wrong math; corrected: 500M tokens at $9/1M = $4,500 per month — but ClinicAI said $30k/month budget. Reconcile: they likely mean gross monthly spend including egress/engineering/support; need to confirm what they count as "tokens" vs total monthly spend.
- Alternate: pilot priced by bundle (flat pilot fee structured to fit procurement): e.g., $30k flat for 500M tokens + accelerated support; equivalent $60 / 1M — that’s outside target. 

Action items (Ben)
- I’ll validate the numbers and produce a slide with: list-price comparatives, effective landed price (including overhead for support), and a quantized vs full-precision delta.
- Also will flag where our recommended $9/1M pilot would be materially out-of-step with ClinicAI’s stated $30k/mo budget — note that their $30k may be total program budget, not pure token spend.

Deliverables by EOD Monday 8/17: one-slide benchmark + updated redwood_token_econ_model.xlsx with markers for assumptions. I’ll attach those to the reply and copy Camila for reserves assumptions.

—Ben
Senior Sales, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | (415) 555-0177
